title: St. Paul Scavenger Hunt Walking Activity
includes: One scavenger hunt interactive walking tour for your entire group
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Must be able to walk around 2 miles.
policies: Must have smartphone with cellular data service.
IMPORTANT: Registration Instructions will be found on the Voucher & Email after completing purchase
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Navigate through the vibrant streets of St. Paul in an interactive scavenger hunt that blends adventure with history. Uncover hidden gems like the Germania Bank building and the iconic Greenman House while learning intriguing stories, including the tale of Billie Frechette and her connection to John Dillinger. This app-led activity allows you to explore at your own pace, making it perfect for families, friends, or couples looking for a unique outing. Enjoy the freedom of no reservations and a flexible schedule, all while experiencing the city's rich heritage.
